**Inheritance:**
java.lang.Object

**All Implemented Interfaces:**
java.lang.Cloneable
```
public class CompatibilityOptions implements Cloneable
```

Contiene opciones de compatibilidad (es decir, las preferencias del usuario ingresadas en la pestaña **Compatibility** del cuadro de diálogo **Options** en Microsoft Word).

Para obtener más información, visite el artículo de documentación [ Detect File Format and Check Format Compatibility ][Detect File Format and Check Format Compatibility].

 **Examples:** 

Mostrar cómo optimizar el documento para diferentes versiones de Microsoft Word.

```

 public void optimizeFor() throws Exception
 {
     Document doc = new Document();

     // This object contains an extensive list of flags unique to each document
     // that allow us to facilitate backward compatibility with older versions of Microsoft Word.
     CompatibilityOptions options = doc.getCompatibilityOptions();

     // Print the default settings for a blank document.
     System.out.println("\nDefault optimization settings:");
     printCompatibilityOptions(options);

     // We can access these settings in Microsoft Word via "File" -> "Options" -> "Advanced" -> "Compatibility options for...".
     doc.save(getArtifactsDir() + "CompatibilityOptions.OptimizeFor.DefaultSettings.docx");

     // We can use the OptimizeFor method to ensure optimal compatibility with a specific Microsoft Word version.
     doc.getCompatibilityOptions().optimizeFor(MsWordVersion.WORD_2010);
     System.out.println("\nOptimized for Word 2010:");
     printCompatibilityOptions(options);

     doc.getCompatibilityOptions().optimizeFor(MsWordVersion.WORD_2000);
     System.out.println("\nOptimized for Word 2000:");
     printCompatibilityOptions(options);
 }

 /// 
 /// Groups all flags in a document's compatibility options object by state, then prints each group.
 ///

     addOptionName(options.getUICompat97To2003(), "UICompat97To2003", enabledOptions, disabledOptions);
     addOptionName(options.getUlTrailSpace(), "UlTrailSpace", enabledOptions, disabledOptions);
     addOptionName(options.getUnderlineTabInNumList(), "UnderlineTabInNumList", enabledOptions, disabledOptions);
     addOptionName(options.getUseAltKinsokuLineBreakRules(), "UseAltKinsokuLineBreakRules", enabledOptions, disabledOptions);
     addOptionName(options.getUseAnsiKerningPairs(), "UseAnsiKerningPairs", enabledOptions, disabledOptions);

     addOptionName(options.getUseNormalStyleForList(), "UseNormalStyleForList", enabledOptions, disabledOptions);
     addOptionName(options.getUsePrinterMetrics(), "UsePrinterMetrics", enabledOptions, disabledOptions);

     addOptionName(options.getUseWord97LineBreakRules(), "UseWord97LineBreakRules", enabledOptions, disabledOptions);
     addOptionName(options.getWPJustification(), "WPJustification", enabledOptions, disabledOptions);
     addOptionName(options.getWPSpaceWidth(), "WPSpaceWidth", enabledOptions, disabledOptions);
     addOptionName(options.getWrapTrailSpaces(), "WrapTrailSpaces", enabledOptions, disabledOptions);
     System.out.println("\tEnabled options:");
     for (String optionName : enabledOptions)
         System.out.println("\t\t{optionName}");
     System.out.println("\tDisabled options:");
     for (String optionName : disabledOptions)
         System.out.println("\t\t{optionName}");
 }

 private static void addOptionName(boolean option, String optionName, ArrayList enabledOptions, ArrayList disabledOptions)
 {
     if (option)
         enabledOptions.add(optionName);
     else
         disabledOptions.add(optionName);
 }

Mostrar cómo establecer una especificación de cumplimiento OOXML para que un documento guardado la cumpla.

```

 Document doc = new Document();
 DocumentBuilder builder = new DocumentBuilder(doc);

 // If we configure compatibility options to comply with Microsoft Word 2003,
 // inserting an image will define its shape using VML.
 doc.getCompatibilityOptions().optimizeFor(MsWordVersion.WORD_2003);
 builder.insertImage(getImageDir() + "Transparent background logo.png");

 Assert.assertEquals(ShapeMarkupLanguage.VML, ((Shape) doc.getChild(NodeType.SHAPE, 0, true)).getMarkupLanguage());

 // The "ISO/IEC 29500:2008" OOXML standard does not support VML shapes.
 // If we set the "Compliance" property of the SaveOptions object to "OoxmlCompliance.Iso29500_2008_Strict",
 // any document we save while passing this object will have to follow that standard.
 OoxmlSaveOptions saveOptions = new OoxmlSaveOptions();
 saveOptions.setCompliance(OoxmlCompliance.ISO_29500_2008_STRICT);
 saveOptions.setSaveFormat(SaveFormat.DOCX);

 doc.save(getArtifactsDir() + "OoxmlSaveOptions.Iso29500Strict.docx", saveOptions);

 // Our saved document defines the shape using DML to adhere to the "ISO/IEC 29500:2008" OOXML standard.
 doc = new Document(getArtifactsDir() + "OoxmlSaveOptions.Iso29500Strict.docx");

 Assert.assertEquals(ShapeMarkupLanguage.DML, ((Shape) doc.getChild(NodeType.SHAPE, 0, true)).getMarkupLanguage());
 
```

Muestra cómo alinear verticalmente el contenido de texto de un cuadro de texto.

```

 Document doc = new Document();
 DocumentBuilder builder = new DocumentBuilder(doc);

 Shape shape = builder.insertShape(ShapeType.TEXT_BOX, 200.0, 200.0);

 // Set the "VerticalAnchor" property to "TextBoxAnchor.Top" to
 // align the text in this text box with the top side of the shape.
 // Set the "VerticalAnchor" property to "TextBoxAnchor.Middle" to
 // align the text in this text box to the center of the shape.
 // Set the "VerticalAnchor" property to "TextBoxAnchor.Bottom" to
 // align the text in this text box to the bottom of the shape.
 shape.getTextBox().setVerticalAnchor(verticalAnchor);

 builder.moveTo(shape.getFirstParagraph());
 builder.write("Hello world!");

 // The vertical aligning of text inside text boxes is available from Microsoft Word 2007 onwards.
 doc.getCompatibilityOptions().optimizeFor(MsWordVersion.WORD_2007);
 doc.save(getArtifactsDir() + "Shape.VerticalAnchor.docx");
 
```

| [getAlignTablesRowByRow()](#getAlignTablesRowByRow) | Alinear filas de tabla de forma independiente. |
| [getAllowSpaceOfSameStyleInTable()](#getAllowSpaceOfSameStyleInTable) | Permitir espaciado contextual de párrafos en tablas. |

| [getAutoSpaceLikeWord95()](#getAutoSpaceLikeWord95) | Emular el espaciado de caracteres de ancho completo de Word 95. |

| [getBalanceSingleByteDoubleByteWidth()](#getBalanceSingleByteDoubleByteWidth) | Equilibrar caracteres de un solo byte y de doble byte. |
| [getCachedColBalance()](#getCachedColBalance) | Usar información de párrafo en caché para equilibrar columnas. |
| [getConvMailMergeEsc()](#getConvMailMergeEsc) | Tratar el delimitador de comillas con barra invertida como dos comillas. |
| [getDisableOpenTypeFontFormattingFeatures()](#getDisableOpenTypeFontFormattingFeatures) | Especifica desactivar las funciones de formato de fuentes OpenType. |
| [getDisplayHangulFixedWidth()](#getDisplayHangulFixedWidth) | Usar siempre ancho fijo para caracteres Hangul. |
| [getDoNotAutofitConstrainedTables()](#getDoNotAutofitConstrainedTables) | No ajustar automáticamente las tablas para que encajen junto a objetos envueltos. |

| [getDoNotBreakWrappedTables()](#getDoNotBreakWrappedTables) | No permitir que las tablas flotantes se dividan entre páginas. |
| [getDoNotExpandShiftReturn()](#getDoNotExpandShiftReturn) | No justificar líneas que terminan en salto de línea suave. |
| [getDoNotLeaveBackslashAlone()](#getDoNotLeaveBackslashAlone) | Convertir la barra invertida a signo de yen al ingresarla. |
| [getDoNotSnapToGridInCell()](#getDoNotSnapToGridInCell) | No ajustar a la cuadrícula del documento en celdas de tabla con objetos. |
| [getDoNotSuppressIndentation()](#getDoNotSuppressIndentation) | No ignorar objetos flotantes al calcular la sangría del párrafo. |
| [getDoNotSuppressParagraphBorders()](#getDoNotSuppressParagraphBorders) | No suprimir bordes de párrafo junto a marcos. |
| [getDoNotUseEastAsianBreakRules()](#getDoNotUseEastAsianBreakRules) | No comprimir caracteres comprimibles al usar la cuadrícula del documento. |
| [getDoNotUseHTMLParagraphAutoSpacing()](#getDoNotUseHTMLParagraphAutoSpacing) | Usar espaciado de párrafo fijo para la configuración automática de HTML. |

| [getDoNotVertAlignInTxbx()](#getDoNotVertAlignInTxbx) | Ignorar alineación vertical en cuadros de texto. |
| [getDoNotWrapTextWithPunct()](#getDoNotWrapTextWithPunct) | No permitir puntuación colgante con cuadrícula de caracteres. |
| [getFootnoteLayoutLikeWW8()](#getFootnoteLayoutLikeWW8) | Emular la ubicación de notas al pie de Word 6.x/95/97. |

| [setForgetLastTabAlignment(boolean value)](#setForgetLastTabAlignment-boolean) | Ignorar el ancho de la última tabulación al alinear el párrafo si no está alineado a la izquierda. |
| [setGrowAutofit(boolean value)](#setGrowAutofit-boolean) | Permitir que las tablas se ajusten automáticamente a los márgenes de la página. |
| [setLayoutRawTableWidth(boolean value)](#setLayoutRawTableWidth-boolean) | Ignorar el espacio antes de la tabla al decidir si la tabla debe envolver un objeto flotante. |
| [setLayoutTableRowsApart(boolean value)](#setLayoutTableRowsApart-boolean) | Permitir que las filas de tabla envuelvan objetos en línea de forma independiente. |
| [setLineWrapLikeWord6(boolean value)](#setLineWrapLikeWord6-boolean) | Emular el ajuste de línea de Word 6.0 para texto de Asia Oriental. |
| [setMWSmallCaps(boolean value)](#setMWSmallCaps-boolean) | Emular Word 5.x para Macintosh con formato de versalitas pequeñas. |
| [setNoColumnBalance(boolean value)](#setNoColumnBalance-boolean) | No equilibrar columnas de texto dentro de una sección. |
| [setNoExtraLineSpacing(boolean value)](#setNoExtraLineSpacing-boolean) | No centrar contenido en líneas con altura de línea exacta. |
| [setNoLeading(boolean value)](#setNoLeading-boolean) | No añadir interlineado entre líneas de texto. |
| [setNoSpaceRaiseLower(boolean value)](#setNoSpaceRaiseLower-boolean) | No aumentar la altura de línea para texto elevado/bajado. |
| [setNoTabHangInd(boolean value)](#setNoTabHangInd-boolean) | No crear tabulación personalizada para sangría colgante. |
| [setOverrideTableStyleFontSizeAndJustification(boolean value)](#setOverrideTableStyleFontSizeAndJustification-boolean) | Especifica cómo se evalúa la jerarquía de estilos del documento. |
| [setPrintBodyTextBeforeHeader(boolean value)](#setPrintBodyTextBeforeHeader-boolean) | Imprimir texto del cuerpo antes del contenido de encabezado/pie de página. |
| [setPrintColBlack(boolean value)](#setPrintColBlack-boolean) | Imprimir colores en blanco y negro sin tramado. |
| [setSelectFldWithFirstOrLastChar(boolean value)](#setSelectFldWithFirstOrLastChar-boolean) | Seleccionar campo cuando se selecciona el primer o último carácter. |
| [setShapeLayoutLikeWW8(boolean value)](#setShapeLayoutLikeWW8-boolean) | Emular el ajuste de texto de Word 97 alrededor de objetos flotantes. |
| [setShowBreaksInFrames(boolean value)](#setShowBreaksInFrames-boolean) | Mostrar saltos de página/columna presentes en marcos. |
| [setSpaceForUL(boolean value)](#setSpaceForUL-boolean) | Añadir espacio adicional bajo la línea base para texto subrayado de Asia oriental. |
| [setSpacingInWholePoints(boolean value)](#setSpacingInWholePoints-boolean) | Solo expandir/contraer texto en puntos completos. |
| [setSplitPgBreakAndParaMark(boolean value)](#setSplitPgBreakAndParaMark-boolean) | Siempre mover la marca de párrafo a la página después de un salto de página. |
| [setSubFontBySize(boolean value)](#setSubFontBySize-boolean) | Incrementar la prioridad del tamaño de fuente durante la sustitución de fuentes. |
| [setSuppressBottomSpacing(boolean value)](#setSuppressBottomSpacing-boolean) | Ignorar la altura de línea exacta para la última línea de la página. |
| [setSuppressSpBfAfterPgBrk(boolean value)](#setSuppressSpBfAfterPgBrk-boolean) | No usar espacio antes en la primera línea después de un salto de página. |
| [setSuppressSpacingAtTopOfPage(boolean value)](#setSuppressSpacingAtTopOfPage-boolean) | Ignorar la altura mínima de línea para la primera línea de la página. |
| [setSuppressTopSpacing(boolean value)](#setSuppressTopSpacing-boolean) | Ignorar la altura mínima y exacta de línea para la primera línea de la página. |
| [setSuppressTopSpacingWP(boolean value)](#setSuppressTopSpacingWP-boolean) | Emular el interlineado de WordPerfect 5.x. |
| [setSwapBordersFacingPgs(boolean value)](#setSwapBordersFacingPgs-boolean) | Intercambiar bordes de párrafo en páginas impares. |
| [setSwapInsideAndOutsideForMirrorIndentsAndRelativePositioning(boolean value)](#setSwapInsideAndOutsideForMirrorIndentsAndRelativePositioning-boolean) | Especifica intercambiar interior y exterior para sangrías espejo y posicionamiento relativo. |
| [setTransparentMetafiles(boolean value)](#setTransparentMetafiles-boolean) | Especifica no borrar el área detrás de imágenes metafile. |
| [setTruncateFontHeightsLikeWP6(boolean value)](#setTruncateFontHeightsLikeWP6-boolean) | Emular el cálculo de altura de fuente de WordPerfect 6.x. |
| [setUICompat97To2003(boolean value)](#setUICompat97To2003-boolean) | Verdadero para desactivar la funcionalidad de UI que no es compatible con Word97-2003. |
| [setUlTrailSpace(boolean value)](#setUlTrailSpace-boolean) | Subrayar todos los espacios finales. |
| [setUnderlineTabInNumList(boolean value)](#setUnderlineTabInNumList-boolean) | Subrayar el carácter siguiente después de la numeración. |
| [setUseAltKinsokuLineBreakRules(boolean value)](#setUseAltKinsokuLineBreakRules-boolean) | Usar conjunto alternativo de reglas de salto de línea de Asia Oriental. |
| [setUseAnsiKerningPairs(boolean value)](#setUseAnsiKerningPairs-boolean) | Usar pares de kerning ANSI de las fuentes. |
| [setUseFELayout(boolean value)](#setUseFELayout-boolean) | No omitir el código de diseño de scripts complejos/Asia Oriental. |
| [setUseNormalStyleForList(boolean value)](#setUseNormalStyleForList-boolean) | No aplicar automáticamente el estilo de párrafo de lista al texto con viñetas/numerado. |
| [setUsePrinterMetrics(boolean value)](#setUsePrinterMetrics-boolean) | Usar métricas de la impresora para mostrar documentos. |
| [setUseSingleBorderforContiguousCells(boolean value)](#setUseSingleBorderforContiguousCells-boolean) | Usar reglas simplificadas para conflictos de bordes de tabla. |
| [setUseWord2002TableStyleRules(boolean value)](#setUseWord2002TableStyleRules-boolean) | Emular reglas de estilo de tabla de Word 2002. |
| [setUseWord2010TableStyleRules(boolean value)](#setUseWord2010TableStyleRules-boolean) | Especifica usar reglas de estilo de tabla de Word2010. |
| [setUseWord97LineBreakRules(boolean value)](#setUseWord97LineBreakRules-boolean) | Emular salto de línea de Asia Oriental de Word 97. |
| [setWPJustification(boolean value)](#setWPJustification-boolean) | Emular justificación de párrafo de WordPerfect 6.x. |
| [setWPSpaceWidth(boolean value)](#setWPSpaceWidth-boolean) | Especifica si establecer el ancho de un espacio como se hace en WordPerfect 5.x. |
| [setWrapTrailSpaces(boolean value)](#setWrapTrailSpaces-boolean) | Ajustar línea de espacios finales. |

 public void optimizeFor() throws Exception
 {
     Document doc = new Document();

     // This object contains an extensive list of flags unique to each document
     // that allow us to facilitate backward compatibility with older versions of Microsoft Word.
     CompatibilityOptions options = doc.getCompatibilityOptions();

     // Print the default settings for a blank document.
     System.out.println("\nDefault optimization settings:");
     printCompatibilityOptions(options);

     // We can access these settings in Microsoft Word via "File" -> "Options" -> "Advanced" -> "Compatibility options for...".
     doc.save(getArtifactsDir() + "CompatibilityOptions.OptimizeFor.DefaultSettings.docx");

     // We can use the OptimizeFor method to ensure optimal compatibility with a specific Microsoft Word version.
     doc.getCompatibilityOptions().optimizeFor(MsWordVersion.WORD_2010);
     System.out.println("\nOptimized for Word 2010:");
     printCompatibilityOptions(options);

     doc.getCompatibilityOptions().optimizeFor(MsWordVersion.WORD_2000);
     System.out.println("\nOptimized for Word 2000:");
     printCompatibilityOptions(options);
 }

     System.out.println("\tEnabled options:");
     for (String optionName : enabledOptions)

     System.out.println("\tDisabled options:");

         System.out.println("\t\t{optionName}");

 private static void addOptionName(boolean option, String optionName, ArrayList enabledOptions, ArrayList disabledOptions)
 {
     if (option)
         enabledOptions.add(optionName);
     else
         disabledOptions.add(optionName);
 }

 public void optimizeFor() throws Exception
 {
     Document doc = new Document();

     // This object contains an extensive list of flags unique to each document
     // that allow us to facilitate backward compatibility with older versions of Microsoft Word.
     CompatibilityOptions options = doc.getCompatibilityOptions();

     // Print the default settings for a blank document.
     System.out.println("\nDefault optimization settings:");
     printCompatibilityOptions(options);

     // We can access these settings in Microsoft Word via "File" -> "Options" -> "Advanced" -> "Compatibility options for...".
     doc.save(getArtifactsDir() + "CompatibilityOptions.OptimizeFor.DefaultSettings.docx");

     // We can use the OptimizeFor method to ensure optimal compatibility with a specific Microsoft Word version.
     doc.getCompatibilityOptions().optimizeFor(MsWordVersion.WORD_2010);
     System.out.println("\nOptimized for Word 2010:");
     printCompatibilityOptions(options);

     doc.getCompatibilityOptions().optimizeFor(MsWordVersion.WORD_2000);
     System.out.println("\nOptimized for Word 2000:");
     printCompatibilityOptions(options);
 }

Permitir que las columnas de tabla excedan los anchos preferidos de las celdas constituyentes.

 **Remarks:** 

La opción se llama "Use Word 2003 table autofit rules" en la interfaz de usuario de MS Word 2013. En realidad también afecta cómo se calcula la cuadrícula para tablas de diseño fijo (en algunos casos).

 **Examples:** 

Mostrar cómo optimizar el documento para diferentes versiones de Microsoft Word.

 public void optimizeFor() throws Exception
 {
     Document doc = new Document();

     // This object contains an extensive list of flags unique to each document
     // that allow us to facilitate backward compatibility with older versions of Microsoft Word.
     CompatibilityOptions options = doc.getCompatibilityOptions();

     // Print the default settings for a blank document.
     System.out.println("\nDefault optimization settings:");
     printCompatibilityOptions(options);

     // We can access these settings in Microsoft Word via "File" -> "Options" -> "Advanced" -> "Compatibility options for...".
     doc.save(getArtifactsDir() + "CompatibilityOptions.OptimizeFor.DefaultSettings.docx");

     // We can use the OptimizeFor method to ensure optimal compatibility with a specific Microsoft Word version.
     doc.getCompatibilityOptions().optimizeFor(MsWordVersion.WORD_2010);
     System.out.println("\nOptimized for Word 2010:");
     printCompatibilityOptions(options);

     doc.getCompatibilityOptions().optimizeFor(MsWordVersion.WORD_2000);
     System.out.println("\nOptimized for Word 2000:");
     printCompatibilityOptions(options);
 }

     CompatibilityOptions options = doc.getCompatibilityOptions();

     // Print the default settings for a blank document.
     System.out.println("\nDefault optimization settings:");
     printCompatibilityOptions(options);

     // We can access these settings in Microsoft Word via "File" -> "Options" -> "Advanced" -> "Compatibility options for...".
     doc.save(getArtifactsDir() + "CompatibilityOptions.OptimizeFor.DefaultSettings.docx");

     // We can use the OptimizeFor method to ensure optimal compatibility with a specific Microsoft Word version.
     doc.getCompatibilityOptions().optimizeFor(MsWordVersion.WORD_2010);

     printCompatibilityOptions(options);

 public void optimizeFor() throws Exception
 {
     Document doc = new Document();

     // This object contains an extensive list of flags unique to each document
     // that allow us to facilitate backward compatibility with older versions of Microsoft Word.
     CompatibilityOptions options = doc.getCompatibilityOptions();

     // Print the default settings for a blank document.
     System.out.println("\nDefault optimization settings:");
     printCompatibilityOptions(options);

     // We can access these settings in Microsoft Word via "File" -> "Options" -> "Advanced" -> "Compatibility options for...".
     doc.save(getArtifactsDir() + "CompatibilityOptions.OptimizeFor.DefaultSettings.docx");

     // We can use the OptimizeFor method to ensure optimal compatibility with a specific Microsoft Word version.
     doc.getCompatibilityOptions().optimizeFor(MsWordVersion.WORD_2010);
     System.out.println("\nOptimized for Word 2010:");
     printCompatibilityOptions(options);

     doc.getCompatibilityOptions().optimizeFor(MsWordVersion.WORD_2000);
     System.out.println("\nOptimized for Word 2000:");
     printCompatibilityOptions(options);

 public void optimizeFor() throws Exception
 {
     Document doc = new Document();

     // This object contains an extensive list of flags unique to each document
     // that allow us to facilitate backward compatibility with older versions of Microsoft Word.
     CompatibilityOptions options = doc.getCompatibilityOptions();

     // Print the default settings for a blank document.
     System.out.println("\nDefault optimization settings:");
     printCompatibilityOptions(options);

     // We can access these settings in Microsoft Word via "File" -> "Options" -> "Advanced" -> "Compatibility options for...".
     doc.save(getArtifactsDir() + "CompatibilityOptions.OptimizeFor.DefaultSettings.docx");

     // We can use the OptimizeFor method to ensure optimal compatibility with a specific Microsoft Word version.
     doc.getCompatibilityOptions().optimizeFor(MsWordVersion.WORD_2010);
     System.out.println("\nOptimized for Word 2010:");
     printCompatibilityOptions(options);

     doc.getCompatibilityOptions().optimizeFor(MsWordVersion.WORD_2000);
     System.out.println("\nOptimized for Word 2000:");
     printCompatibilityOptions(options);

 public void optimizeFor() throws Exception
 {
     Document doc = new Document();

     // This object contains an extensive list of flags unique to each document
     // that allow us to facilitate backward compatibility with older versions of Microsoft Word.
     CompatibilityOptions options = doc.getCompatibilityOptions();

     // Print the default settings for a blank document.
     System.out.println("\nDefault optimization settings:");
     printCompatibilityOptions(options);

     // We can access these settings in Microsoft Word via "File" -> "Options" -> "Advanced" -> "Compatibility options for...".
     doc.save(getArtifactsDir() + "CompatibilityOptions.OptimizeFor.DefaultSettings.docx");

     // We can use the OptimizeFor method to ensure optimal compatibility with a specific Microsoft Word version.
     doc.getCompatibilityOptions().optimizeFor(MsWordVersion.WORD_2010);
     System.out.println("\nOptimized for Word 2010:");
     printCompatibilityOptions(options);

     doc.getCompatibilityOptions().optimizeFor(MsWordVersion.WORD_2000);
     System.out.println("\nOptimized for Word 2000:");
     printCompatibilityOptions(options);
 }

### getForgetLastTabAlignment() {#getForgetLastTabAlignment}
```
public boolean getForgetLastTabAlignment()
```


Ignorar el ancho de la última tabulación al alinear el párrafo si no está alineado a la izquierda.

Mostrar cómo optimizar el documento para diferentes versiones de Microsoft Word.

 public void optimizeFor() throws Exception
 {
     Document doc = new Document();

     // This object contains an extensive list of flags unique to each document
     // that allow us to facilitate backward compatibility with older versions of Microsoft Word.
     CompatibilityOptions options = doc.getCompatibilityOptions();

     // Print the default settings for a blank document.
     System.out.println("\nDefault optimization settings:");
     printCompatibilityOptions(options);

     // We can access these settings in Microsoft Word via "File" -> "Options" -> "Advanced" -> "Compatibility options for...".
     doc.save(getArtifactsDir() + "CompatibilityOptions.OptimizeFor.DefaultSettings.docx");

     // We can use the OptimizeFor method to ensure optimal compatibility with a specific Microsoft Word version.
     doc.getCompatibilityOptions().optimizeFor(MsWordVersion.WORD_2010);
     System.out.println("\nOptimized for Word 2010:");
     printCompatibilityOptions(options);

     doc.getCompatibilityOptions().optimizeFor(MsWordVersion.WORD_2000);
     System.out.println("\nOptimized for Word 2000:");
     printCompatibilityOptions(options);

     doc.save(getArtifactsDir() + "CompatibilityOptions.OptimizeFor.DefaultSettings.docx");

 public void optimizeFor() throws Exception
 {
     Document doc = new Document();

     // This object contains an extensive list of flags unique to each document
     // that allow us to facilitate backward compatibility with older versions of Microsoft Word.
     CompatibilityOptions options = doc.getCompatibilityOptions();

     // Print the default settings for a blank document.
     System.out.println("\nDefault optimization settings:");
     printCompatibilityOptions(options);

     // We can access these settings in Microsoft Word via "File" -> "Options" -> "Advanced" -> "Compatibility options for...".
     doc.save(getArtifactsDir() + "CompatibilityOptions.OptimizeFor.DefaultSettings.docx");

     // We can use the OptimizeFor method to ensure optimal compatibility with a specific Microsoft Word version.
     doc.getCompatibilityOptions().optimizeFor(MsWordVersion.WORD_2010);
     System.out.println("\nOptimized for Word 2010:");
     printCompatibilityOptions(options);

     doc.getCompatibilityOptions().optimizeFor(MsWordVersion.WORD_2000);
     System.out.println("\nOptimized for Word 2000:");
     printCompatibilityOptions(options);
 }

     CompatibilityOptions options = doc.getCompatibilityOptions();

     // Print the default settings for a blank document.
     System.out.println("\nDefault optimization settings:");
     printCompatibilityOptions(options);

     // We can access these settings in Microsoft Word via "File" -> "Options" -> "Advanced" -> "Compatibility options for...".
     doc.save(getArtifactsDir() + "CompatibilityOptions.OptimizeFor.DefaultSettings.docx");

     // We can use the OptimizeFor method to ensure optimal compatibility with a specific Microsoft Word version.
     doc.getCompatibilityOptions().optimizeFor(MsWordVersion.WORD_2010);

     printCompatibilityOptions(options);

 public void optimizeFor() throws Exception
 {
     Document doc = new Document();

     // This object contains an extensive list of flags unique to each document
     // that allow us to facilitate backward compatibility with older versions of Microsoft Word.
     CompatibilityOptions options = doc.getCompatibilityOptions();

     // Print the default settings for a blank document.
     System.out.println("\nDefault optimization settings:");
     printCompatibilityOptions(options);

     // We can access these settings in Microsoft Word via "File" -> "Options" -> "Advanced" -> "Compatibility options for...".
     doc.save(getArtifactsDir() + "CompatibilityOptions.OptimizeFor.DefaultSettings.docx");

     // We can use the OptimizeFor method to ensure optimal compatibility with a specific Microsoft Word version.
     doc.getCompatibilityOptions().optimizeFor(MsWordVersion.WORD_2010);
     System.out.println("\nOptimized for Word 2010:");
     printCompatibilityOptions(options);

     doc.getCompatibilityOptions().optimizeFor(MsWordVersion.WORD_2000);
     System.out.println("\nOptimized for Word 2000:");
     printCompatibilityOptions(options);
 }

 public void optimizeFor() throws Exception
 {
     Document doc = new Document();

     // This object contains an extensive list of flags unique to each document
     // that allow us to facilitate backward compatibility with older versions of Microsoft Word.
     CompatibilityOptions options = doc.getCompatibilityOptions();

     // Print the default settings for a blank document.
     System.out.println("\nDefault optimization settings:");
     printCompatibilityOptions(options);

     // We can access these settings in Microsoft Word via "File" -> "Options" -> "Advanced" -> "Compatibility options for...".
     doc.save(getArtifactsDir() + "CompatibilityOptions.OptimizeFor.DefaultSettings.docx");

     // We can use the OptimizeFor method to ensure optimal compatibility with a specific Microsoft Word version.
     doc.getCompatibilityOptions().optimizeFor(MsWordVersion.WORD_2010);
     System.out.println("\nOptimized for Word 2010:");
     printCompatibilityOptions(options);

     doc.getCompatibilityOptions().optimizeFor(MsWordVersion.WORD_2000);
     System.out.println("\nOptimized for Word 2000:");
     printCompatibilityOptions(options);
 }

 public void optimizeFor() throws Exception
 {
     Document doc = new Document();

     // This object contains an extensive list of flags unique to each document
     // that allow us to facilitate backward compatibility with older versions of Microsoft Word.
     CompatibilityOptions options = doc.getCompatibilityOptions();

     // Print the default settings for a blank document.
     System.out.println("\nDefault optimization settings:");
     printCompatibilityOptions(options);

     // We can access these settings in Microsoft Word via "File" -> "Options" -> "Advanced" -> "Compatibility options for...".
     doc.save(getArtifactsDir() + "CompatibilityOptions.OptimizeFor.DefaultSettings.docx");

     // We can use the OptimizeFor method to ensure optimal compatibility with a specific Microsoft Word version.
     doc.getCompatibilityOptions().optimizeFor(MsWordVersion.WORD_2010);
     System.out.println("\nOptimized for Word 2010:");
     printCompatibilityOptions(options);

     doc.getCompatibilityOptions().optimizeFor(MsWordVersion.WORD_2000);
     System.out.println("\nOptimized for Word 2000:");
     printCompatibilityOptions(options);
 }

### getUICompat97To2003() {#getUICompat97To2003}
```
public boolean getUICompat97To2003()
```


Verdadero para desactivar la funcionalidad de UI que no es compatible con Word97-2003. El valor predeterminado es false.

 **Remarks:** 

Controla la configuración de compatibilidad Word97-2003 que desactiva la funcionalidad de UI que no es compatible con Word97-2003. Cuando true, el elemento XML 'w:uiCompat97To2003' se escribe en la parte del paquete de documentos '\\word\\settings.xml'. El valor predeterminado es false. Cuando se establece en false, este elemento no se escribe. Técnicamente esta propiedad no forma parte de las opciones de compatibilidad, pero la hemos colocado aquí por conveniencia de la API.

Mostrar cómo optimizar el documento para diferentes versiones de Microsoft Word.

 public void optimizeFor() throws Exception

     // that allow us to facilitate backward compatibility with older versions of Microsoft Word.
     CompatibilityOptions options = doc.getCompatibilityOptions();

     // Print the default settings for a blank document.
     System.out.println("\nDefault optimization settings:");
     printCompatibilityOptions(options);

     // We can access these settings in Microsoft Word via "File" -> "Options" -> "Advanced" -> "Compatibility options for...".
     doc.save(getArtifactsDir() + "CompatibilityOptions.OptimizeFor.DefaultSettings.docx");

     // We can use the OptimizeFor method to ensure optimal compatibility with a specific Microsoft Word version.
     doc.getCompatibilityOptions().optimizeFor(MsWordVersion.WORD_2010);
     System.out.println("\nOptimized for Word 2010:");
     printCompatibilityOptions(options);

     doc.getCompatibilityOptions().optimizeFor(MsWordVersion.WORD_2000);

     printCompatibilityOptions(options);

### getUsePrinterMetrics() {#getUsePrinterMetrics}
```
public boolean getUsePrinterMetrics()
```


Usar métricas de la impresora para mostrar documentos.

 **Remarks:** 

Las métricas de la impresora pueden variar según los controladores utilizados. Por ejemplo, Windows "Microsoft OpenXPS Class Driver 2" y "Microsoft Print to PDF" proporcionan métricas ligeramente diferentes. Por lo tanto, el diseño del documento final puede cambiar si esta opción está habilitada.

 **Examples:** 

Mostrar cómo optimizar el documento para diferentes versiones de Microsoft Word.

 public void optimizeFor() throws Exception
 {
     Document doc = new Document();

     // This object contains an extensive list of flags unique to each document
     // that allow us to facilitate backward compatibility with older versions of Microsoft Word.
     CompatibilityOptions options = doc.getCompatibilityOptions();

     // Print the default settings for a blank document.
     System.out.println("\nDefault optimization settings:");
     printCompatibilityOptions(options);

     // We can access these settings in Microsoft Word via "File" -> "Options" -> "Advanced" -> "Compatibility options for...".
     doc.save(getArtifactsDir() + "CompatibilityOptions.OptimizeFor.DefaultSettings.docx");

     // We can use the OptimizeFor method to ensure optimal compatibility with a specific Microsoft Word version.
     doc.getCompatibilityOptions().optimizeFor(MsWordVersion.WORD_2010);
     System.out.println("\nOptimized for Word 2010:");
     printCompatibilityOptions(options);

     doc.getCompatibilityOptions().optimizeFor(MsWordVersion.WORD_2000);
     System.out.println("\nOptimized for Word 2000:");
     printCompatibilityOptions(options);
 }

 public void optimizeFor() throws Exception
 {
     Document doc = new Document();

     // This object contains an extensive list of flags unique to each document
     // that allow us to facilitate backward compatibility with older versions of Microsoft Word.
     CompatibilityOptions options = doc.getCompatibilityOptions();

     // Print the default settings for a blank document.
     System.out.println("\nDefault optimization settings:");
     printCompatibilityOptions(options);

     // We can access these settings in Microsoft Word via "File" -> "Options" -> "Advanced" -> "Compatibility options for...".
     doc.save(getArtifactsDir() + "CompatibilityOptions.OptimizeFor.DefaultSettings.docx");

     // We can use the OptimizeFor method to ensure optimal compatibility with a specific Microsoft Word version.
     doc.getCompatibilityOptions().optimizeFor(MsWordVersion.WORD_2010);
     System.out.println("\nOptimized for Word 2010:");
     printCompatibilityOptions(options);

     doc.getCompatibilityOptions().optimizeFor(MsWordVersion.WORD_2000);
     System.out.println("\nOptimized for Word 2000:");
     printCompatibilityOptions(options);
 }

 public void optimizeFor() throws Exception
 {
     Document doc = new Document();

     // This object contains an extensive list of flags unique to each document
     // that allow us to facilitate backward compatibility with older versions of Microsoft Word.
     CompatibilityOptions options = doc.getCompatibilityOptions();

     // Print the default settings for a blank document.
     System.out.println("\nDefault optimization settings:");
     printCompatibilityOptions(options);

     // We can access these settings in Microsoft Word via "File" -> "Options" -> "Advanced" -> "Compatibility options for...".
     doc.save(getArtifactsDir() + "CompatibilityOptions.OptimizeFor.DefaultSettings.docx");

     // We can use the OptimizeFor method to ensure optimal compatibility with a specific Microsoft Word version.
     doc.getCompatibilityOptions().optimizeFor(MsWordVersion.WORD_2010);
     System.out.println("\nOptimized for Word 2010:");
     printCompatibilityOptions(options);

     doc.getCompatibilityOptions().optimizeFor(MsWordVersion.WORD_2000);
     System.out.println("\nOptimized for Word 2000:");
     printCompatibilityOptions(options);
 }

 public void optimizeFor() throws Exception
 {
     Document doc = new Document();

     // This object contains an extensive list of flags unique to each document
     // that allow us to facilitate backward compatibility with older versions of Microsoft Word.
     CompatibilityOptions options = doc.getCompatibilityOptions();

     // Print the default settings for a blank document.
     System.out.println("\nDefault optimization settings:");
     printCompatibilityOptions(options);

     // We can access these settings in Microsoft Word via "File" -> "Options" -> "Advanced" -> "Compatibility options for...".
     doc.save(getArtifactsDir() + "CompatibilityOptions.OptimizeFor.DefaultSettings.docx");

     // We can use the OptimizeFor method to ensure optimal compatibility with a specific Microsoft Word version.
     doc.getCompatibilityOptions().optimizeFor(MsWordVersion.WORD_2010);
     System.out.println("\nOptimized for Word 2010:");
     printCompatibilityOptions(options);

     doc.getCompatibilityOptions().optimizeFor(MsWordVersion.WORD_2000);
     System.out.println("\nOptimized for Word 2000:");
     printCompatibilityOptions(options);
 }

### setAutofitToFirstFixedWidthCell(boolean value) {#setAutofitToFirstFixedWidthCell-boolean}
```
public void setAutofitToFirstFixedWidthCell(boolean value)
```


Permitir que las columnas de tabla excedan los anchos preferidos de las celdas constituyentes.

 **Remarks:** 

La opción se llama "Use Word 2003 table autofit rules" en la interfaz de usuario de MS Word 2013. En realidad también afecta cómo se calcula la cuadrícula para tablas de diseño fijo (en algunos casos).

     CompatibilityOptions options = doc.getCompatibilityOptions();

     // Print the default settings for a blank document.
     System.out.println("\nDefault optimization settings:");
     printCompatibilityOptions(options);

     // We can access these settings in Microsoft Word via "File" -> "Options" -> "Advanced" -> "Compatibility options for...".
     doc.save(getArtifactsDir() + "CompatibilityOptions.OptimizeFor.DefaultSettings.docx");

     // We can use the OptimizeFor method to ensure optimal compatibility with a specific Microsoft Word version.
     doc.getCompatibilityOptions().optimizeFor(MsWordVersion.WORD_2010);

     printCompatibilityOptions(options);

 public void optimizeFor() throws Exception
 {
     Document doc = new Document();

     // This object contains an extensive list of flags unique to each document
     // that allow us to facilitate backward compatibility with older versions of Microsoft Word.
     CompatibilityOptions options = doc.getCompatibilityOptions();

     // Print the default settings for a blank document.
     System.out.println("\nDefault optimization settings:");
     printCompatibilityOptions(options);

     // We can access these settings in Microsoft Word via "File" -> "Options" -> "Advanced" -> "Compatibility options for...".
     doc.save(getArtifactsDir() + "CompatibilityOptions.OptimizeFor.DefaultSettings.docx");

     // We can use the OptimizeFor method to ensure optimal compatibility with a specific Microsoft Word version.
     doc.getCompatibilityOptions().optimizeFor(MsWordVersion.WORD_2010);
     System.out.println("\nOptimized for Word 2010:");
     printCompatibilityOptions(options);

     doc.getCompatibilityOptions().optimizeFor(MsWordVersion.WORD_2000);
     System.out.println("\nOptimized for Word 2000:");
     printCompatibilityOptions(options);
 }

 public void optimizeFor() throws Exception
 {
     Document doc = new Document();

     // This object contains an extensive list of flags unique to each document
     // that allow us to facilitate backward compatibility with older versions of Microsoft Word.
     CompatibilityOptions options = doc.getCompatibilityOptions();

     // Print the default settings for a blank document.
     System.out.println("\nDefault optimization settings:");
     printCompatibilityOptions(options);

     // We can access these settings in Microsoft Word via "File" -> "Options" -> "Advanced" -> "Compatibility options for...".
     doc.save(getArtifactsDir() + "CompatibilityOptions.OptimizeFor.DefaultSettings.docx");

     // We can use the OptimizeFor method to ensure optimal compatibility with a specific Microsoft Word version.
     doc.getCompatibilityOptions().optimizeFor(MsWordVersion.WORD_2010);
     System.out.println("\nOptimized for Word 2010:");
     printCompatibilityOptions(options);

     doc.getCompatibilityOptions().optimizeFor(MsWordVersion.WORD_2000);
     System.out.println("\nOptimized for Word 2000:");
     printCompatibilityOptions(options);
 }

 public void optimizeFor() throws Exception
 {
     Document doc = new Document();

     // This object contains an extensive list of flags unique to each document
     // that allow us to facilitate backward compatibility with older versions of Microsoft Word.
     CompatibilityOptions options = doc.getCompatibilityOptions();

     // Print the default settings for a blank document.
     System.out.println("\nDefault optimization settings:");
     printCompatibilityOptions(options);

     // We can access these settings in Microsoft Word via "File" -> "Options" -> "Advanced" -> "Compatibility options for...".
     doc.save(getArtifactsDir() + "CompatibilityOptions.OptimizeFor.DefaultSettings.docx");

     // We can use the OptimizeFor method to ensure optimal compatibility with a specific Microsoft Word version.
     doc.getCompatibilityOptions().optimizeFor(MsWordVersion.WORD_2010);
     System.out.println("\nOptimized for Word 2010:");
     printCompatibilityOptions(options);

     doc.getCompatibilityOptions().optimizeFor(MsWordVersion.WORD_2000);
     System.out.println("\nOptimized for Word 2000:");
     printCompatibilityOptions(options);
 }

 public void optimizeFor() throws Exception
 {
     Document doc = new Document();

     // This object contains an extensive list of flags unique to each document
     // that allow us to facilitate backward compatibility with older versions of Microsoft Word.
     CompatibilityOptions options = doc.getCompatibilityOptions();

     // Print the default settings for a blank document.
     System.out.println("\nDefault optimization settings:");
     printCompatibilityOptions(options);

     // We can access these settings in Microsoft Word via "File" -> "Options" -> "Advanced" -> "Compatibility options for...".
     doc.save(getArtifactsDir() + "CompatibilityOptions.OptimizeFor.DefaultSettings.docx");

     // We can use the OptimizeFor method to ensure optimal compatibility with a specific Microsoft Word version.
     doc.getCompatibilityOptions().optimizeFor(MsWordVersion.WORD_2010);
     System.out.println("\nOptimized for Word 2010:");
     printCompatibilityOptions(options);

     doc.getCompatibilityOptions().optimizeFor(MsWordVersion.WORD_2000);
     System.out.println("\nOptimized for Word 2000:");
     printCompatibilityOptions(options);
 }

     CompatibilityOptions options = doc.getCompatibilityOptions();

     // Print the default settings for a blank document.
     System.out.println("\nDefault optimization settings:");
     printCompatibilityOptions(options);

     // We can access these settings in Microsoft Word via "File" -> "Options" -> "Advanced" -> "Compatibility options for...".
     doc.save(getArtifactsDir() + "CompatibilityOptions.OptimizeFor.DefaultSettings.docx");

     // We can use the OptimizeFor method to ensure optimal compatibility with a specific Microsoft Word version.
     doc.getCompatibilityOptions().optimizeFor(MsWordVersion.WORD_2010);
     System.out.println("\nOptimized for Word 2010:");
     printCompatibilityOptions(options);

     doc.getCompatibilityOptions().optimizeFor(MsWordVersion.WORD_2000);

 public void optimizeFor() throws Exception
 {
     Document doc = new Document();

     // This object contains an extensive list of flags unique to each document
     // that allow us to facilitate backward compatibility with older versions of Microsoft Word.
     CompatibilityOptions options = doc.getCompatibilityOptions();

     // Print the default settings for a blank document.
     System.out.println("\nDefault optimization settings:");
     printCompatibilityOptions(options);

     // We can access these settings in Microsoft Word via "File" -> "Options" -> "Advanced" -> "Compatibility options for...".
     doc.save(getArtifactsDir() + "CompatibilityOptions.OptimizeFor.DefaultSettings.docx");

     // We can use the OptimizeFor method to ensure optimal compatibility with a specific Microsoft Word version.
     doc.getCompatibilityOptions().optimizeFor(MsWordVersion.WORD_2010);
     System.out.println("\nOptimized for Word 2010:");
     printCompatibilityOptions(options);

     doc.getCompatibilityOptions().optimizeFor(MsWordVersion.WORD_2000);
     System.out.println("\nOptimized for Word 2000:");
     printCompatibilityOptions(options);

 public void optimizeFor() throws Exception
 {
     Document doc = new Document();

     // This object contains an extensive list of flags unique to each document
     // that allow us to facilitate backward compatibility with older versions of Microsoft Word.
     CompatibilityOptions options = doc.getCompatibilityOptions();

     // Print the default settings for a blank document.
     System.out.println("\nDefault optimization settings:");
     printCompatibilityOptions(options);

     // We can access these settings in Microsoft Word via "File" -> "Options" -> "Advanced" -> "Compatibility options for...".
     doc.save(getArtifactsDir() + "CompatibilityOptions.OptimizeFor.DefaultSettings.docx");

     // We can use the OptimizeFor method to ensure optimal compatibility with a specific Microsoft Word version.
     doc.getCompatibilityOptions().optimizeFor(MsWordVersion.WORD_2010);
     System.out.println("\nOptimized for Word 2010:");
     printCompatibilityOptions(options);

     doc.getCompatibilityOptions().optimizeFor(MsWordVersion.WORD_2000);
     System.out.println("\nOptimized for Word 2000:");
     printCompatibilityOptions(options);
 }

 public void optimizeFor() throws Exception
 {
     Document doc = new Document();

     // This object contains an extensive list of flags unique to each document
     // that allow us to facilitate backward compatibility with older versions of Microsoft Word.
     CompatibilityOptions options = doc.getCompatibilityOptions();

     // Print the default settings for a blank document.
     System.out.println("\nDefault optimization settings:");
     printCompatibilityOptions(options);

     // We can access these settings in Microsoft Word via "File" -> "Options" -> "Advanced" -> "Compatibility options for...".
     doc.save(getArtifactsDir() + "CompatibilityOptions.OptimizeFor.DefaultSettings.docx");

     // We can use the OptimizeFor method to ensure optimal compatibility with a specific Microsoft Word version.
     doc.getCompatibilityOptions().optimizeFor(MsWordVersion.WORD_2010);
     System.out.println("\nOptimized for Word 2010:");
     printCompatibilityOptions(options);

     doc.getCompatibilityOptions().optimizeFor(MsWordVersion.WORD_2000);
     System.out.println("\nOptimized for Word 2000:");
     printCompatibilityOptions(options);
 }

 {

     // This object contains an extensive list of flags unique to each document
     // that allow us to facilitate backward compatibility with older versions of Microsoft Word.
     CompatibilityOptions options = doc.getCompatibilityOptions();

     // Print the default settings for a blank document.
     System.out.println("\nDefault optimization settings:");
     printCompatibilityOptions(options);

     // We can access these settings in Microsoft Word via "File" -> "Options" -> "Advanced" -> "Compatibility options for...".
     doc.save(getArtifactsDir() + "CompatibilityOptions.OptimizeFor.DefaultSettings.docx");

     // We can use the OptimizeFor method to ensure optimal compatibility with a specific Microsoft Word version.

     printCompatibilityOptions(options);

     doc.getCompatibilityOptions().optimizeFor(MsWordVersion.WORD_2000);

     printCompatibilityOptions(options);
 }

 public void optimizeFor() throws Exception
 {
     Document doc = new Document();

     // This object contains an extensive list of flags unique to each document
     // that allow us to facilitate backward compatibility with older versions of Microsoft Word.
     CompatibilityOptions options = doc.getCompatibilityOptions();

     // Print the default settings for a blank document.
     System.out.println("\nDefault optimization settings:");
     printCompatibilityOptions(options);

     // We can access these settings in Microsoft Word via "File" -> "Options" -> "Advanced" -> "Compatibility options for...".
     doc.save(getArtifactsDir() + "CompatibilityOptions.OptimizeFor.DefaultSettings.docx");

     // We can use the OptimizeFor method to ensure optimal compatibility with a specific Microsoft Word version.
     doc.getCompatibilityOptions().optimizeFor(MsWordVersion.WORD_2010);
     System.out.println("\nOptimized for Word 2010:");
     printCompatibilityOptions(options);

     doc.getCompatibilityOptions().optimizeFor(MsWordVersion.WORD_2000);
     System.out.println("\nOptimized for Word 2000:");
     printCompatibilityOptions(options);
 }

 public void optimizeFor() throws Exception
 {
     Document doc = new Document();

     // This object contains an extensive list of flags unique to each document
     // that allow us to facilitate backward compatibility with older versions of Microsoft Word.
     CompatibilityOptions options = doc.getCompatibilityOptions();

     // Print the default settings for a blank document.
     System.out.println("\nDefault optimization settings:");
     printCompatibilityOptions(options);

     // We can access these settings in Microsoft Word via "File" -> "Options" -> "Advanced" -> "Compatibility options for...".
     doc.save(getArtifactsDir() + "CompatibilityOptions.OptimizeFor.DefaultSettings.docx");

     // We can use the OptimizeFor method to ensure optimal compatibility with a specific Microsoft Word version.
     doc.getCompatibilityOptions().optimizeFor(MsWordVersion.WORD_2010);
     System.out.println("\nOptimized for Word 2010:");
     printCompatibilityOptions(options);

     doc.getCompatibilityOptions().optimizeFor(MsWordVersion.WORD_2000);
     System.out.println("\nOptimized for Word 2000:");
     printCompatibilityOptions(options);
 }

 public void optimizeFor() throws Exception
 {
     Document doc = new Document();

     // This object contains an extensive list of flags unique to each document
     // that allow us to facilitate backward compatibility with older versions of Microsoft Word.
     CompatibilityOptions options = doc.getCompatibilityOptions();

     // Print the default settings for a blank document.
     System.out.println("\nDefault optimization settings:");
     printCompatibilityOptions(options);

     // We can access these settings in Microsoft Word via "File" -> "Options" -> "Advanced" -> "Compatibility options for...".
     doc.save(getArtifactsDir() + "CompatibilityOptions.OptimizeFor.DefaultSettings.docx");

     // We can use the OptimizeFor method to ensure optimal compatibility with a specific Microsoft Word version.
     doc.getCompatibilityOptions().optimizeFor(MsWordVersion.WORD_2010);
     System.out.println("\nOptimized for Word 2010:");
     printCompatibilityOptions(options);

     doc.getCompatibilityOptions().optimizeFor(MsWordVersion.WORD_2000);
     System.out.println("\nOptimized for Word 2000:");
     printCompatibilityOptions(options);
 }

 {
     Document doc = new Document();

     // This object contains an extensive list of flags unique to each document
     // that allow us to facilitate backward compatibility with older versions of Microsoft Word.
     CompatibilityOptions options = doc.getCompatibilityOptions();

     // Print the default settings for a blank document.
     System.out.println("\nDefault optimization settings:");
     printCompatibilityOptions(options);

     // We can access these settings in Microsoft Word via "File" -> "Options" -> "Advanced" -> "Compatibility options for...".
     doc.save(getArtifactsDir() + "CompatibilityOptions.OptimizeFor.DefaultSettings.docx");

     // We can use the OptimizeFor method to ensure optimal compatibility with a specific Microsoft Word version.
     doc.getCompatibilityOptions().optimizeFor(MsWordVersion.WORD_2010);
     System.out.println("\nOptimized for Word 2010:");
     printCompatibilityOptions(options);

     doc.getCompatibilityOptions().optimizeFor(MsWordVersion.WORD_2000);
     System.out.println("\nOptimized for Word 2000:");
     printCompatibilityOptions(options);
 }

### setUICompat97To2003(boolean value) {#setUICompat97To2003-boolean}
```
public void setUICompat97To2003(boolean value)
```


Verdadero para desactivar la funcionalidad de UI que no es compatible con Word97-2003. El valor predeterminado es false.

 **Remarks:** 

Controla la configuración de compatibilidad Word97-2003 que desactiva la funcionalidad de UI que no es compatible con Word97-2003. Cuando true, el elemento XML 'w:uiCompat97To2003' se escribe en la parte del paquete de documentos '\\word\\settings.xml'. El valor predeterminado es false. Cuando se establece en false, este elemento no se escribe. Técnicamente esta propiedad no forma parte de las opciones de compatibilidad, pero la hemos colocado aquí por conveniencia de la API.

 **Examples:**

 public void optimizeFor() throws Exception
 {
     Document doc = new Document();

     // This object contains an extensive list of flags unique to each document
     // that allow us to facilitate backward compatibility with older versions of Microsoft Word.
     CompatibilityOptions options = doc.getCompatibilityOptions();

     // Print the default settings for a blank document.
     System.out.println("\nDefault optimization settings:");
     printCompatibilityOptions(options);

     // We can access these settings in Microsoft Word via "File" -> "Options" -> "Advanced" -> "Compatibility options for...".
     doc.save(getArtifactsDir() + "CompatibilityOptions.OptimizeFor.DefaultSettings.docx");

     // We can use the OptimizeFor method to ensure optimal compatibility with a specific Microsoft Word version.
     doc.getCompatibilityOptions().optimizeFor(MsWordVersion.WORD_2010);
     System.out.println("\nOptimized for Word 2010:");
     printCompatibilityOptions(options);

     doc.getCompatibilityOptions().optimizeFor(MsWordVersion.WORD_2000);
     System.out.println("\nOptimized for Word 2000:");
     printCompatibilityOptions(options);
 }

### setUsePrinterMetrics(boolean value) {#setUsePrinterMetrics-boolean}
```
public void setUsePrinterMetrics(boolean value)
```


Usar métricas de la impresora para mostrar documentos.

 **Remarks:** 

Las métricas de la impresora pueden variar según los controladores utilizados. Por ejemplo, Windows "Microsoft OpenXPS Class Driver 2" y "Microsoft Print to PDF" proporcionan métricas ligeramente diferentes. Por lo tanto, el diseño del documento final puede cambiar si esta opción está habilitada.

 **Examples:** 

Mostrar cómo optimizar el documento para diferentes versiones de Microsoft Word.

```

 public void optimizeFor() throws Exception
 {
     Document doc = new Document();

     // This object contains an extensive list of flags unique to each document
     // that allow us to facilitate backward compatibility with older versions of Microsoft Word.
     CompatibilityOptions options = doc.getCompatibilityOptions();

     // Print the default settings for a blank document.
     System.out.println("\nDefault optimization settings:");
     printCompatibilityOptions(options);

     // We can access these settings in Microsoft Word via "File" -> "Options" -> "Advanced" -> "Compatibility options for...".
     doc.save(getArtifactsDir() + "CompatibilityOptions.OptimizeFor.DefaultSettings.docx");

     // We can use the OptimizeFor method to ensure optimal compatibility with a specific Microsoft Word version.
     doc.getCompatibilityOptions().optimizeFor(MsWordVersion.WORD_2010);
     System.out.println("\nOptimized for Word 2010:");
     printCompatibilityOptions(options);

     doc.getCompatibilityOptions().optimizeFor(MsWordVersion.WORD_2000);
     System.out.println("\nOptimized for Word 2000:");
     printCompatibilityOptions(options);
 }

 public void optimizeFor() throws Exception
 {
     Document doc = new Document();

     // This object contains an extensive list of flags unique to each document
     // that allow us to facilitate backward compatibility with older versions of Microsoft Word.
     CompatibilityOptions options = doc.getCompatibilityOptions();

     // Print the default settings for a blank document.
     System.out.println("\nDefault optimization settings:");
     printCompatibilityOptions(options);

     // We can access these settings in Microsoft Word via "File" -> "Options" -> "Advanced" -> "Compatibility options for...".
     doc.save(getArtifactsDir() + "CompatibilityOptions.OptimizeFor.DefaultSettings.docx");

     // We can use the OptimizeFor method to ensure optimal compatibility with a specific Microsoft Word version.
     doc.getCompatibilityOptions().optimizeFor(MsWordVersion.WORD_2010);
     System.out.println("\nOptimized for Word 2010:");
     printCompatibilityOptions(options);

     doc.getCompatibilityOptions().optimizeFor(MsWordVersion.WORD_2000);
     System.out.println("\nOptimized for Word 2000:");
     printCompatibilityOptions(options);
 }

 public void optimizeFor() throws Exception
 {
     Document doc = new Document();

     // This object contains an extensive list of flags unique to each document
     // that allow us to facilitate backward compatibility with older versions of Microsoft Word.
     CompatibilityOptions options = doc.getCompatibilityOptions();

     // Print the default settings for a blank document.
     System.out.println("\nDefault optimization settings:");
     printCompatibilityOptions(options);

     // We can access these settings in Microsoft Word via "File" -> "Options" -> "Advanced" -> "Compatibility options for...".
     doc.save(getArtifactsDir() + "CompatibilityOptions.OptimizeFor.DefaultSettings.docx");

     // We can use the OptimizeFor method to ensure optimal compatibility with a specific Microsoft Word version.
     doc.getCompatibilityOptions().optimizeFor(MsWordVersion.WORD_2010);
     System.out.println("\nOptimized for Word 2010:");
     printCompatibilityOptions(options);

     doc.getCompatibilityOptions().optimizeFor(MsWordVersion.WORD_2000);
     System.out.println("\nOptimized for Word 2000:");
     printCompatibilityOptions(options);
 }
